question: According to the Third Advance Estimates of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, what is the estimated total foodgrain production in India for 2024-25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3539.59 LMT**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**, the **third advance estimates** for the year **2024-25** forecast India's total food grain production to be **3539.59 LMT (Lakh Metric Tonnes)**.
 
• This estimate includes the production of major food grains such as **rice, wheat, pulses, and coarse cereals**.
 
• The increase in food grain production is attributed to the implementation of advanced **agricultural practices**, favorable **weather conditions**, and government initiatives like **PM Kisan Samman Nidhi**, and subsidies on fertilizers and seeds.
 
• **Rice** and **wheat** continue to be the leading contributors to the total production, reflecting India's agricultural focus on these staple crops.
